_about: Components whose build intentionally differs from their preview.html (ENG-009). Each reason points to a decision. A component over the 1% threshold that is not listed here fails the test.
Badge: Preview label 'Free cancellation' replaced with 'Confirmed' (no invented policy claim, ADR-007).
Button: Link label 'Browse 48 cruises' became 'Browse cruises' (no invented count).
TextField: Hint 'We reply within one working day' replaced (no invented commitment).
VesselArt: Felucca variant removed (ADR-008): three vessels instead of four.
Scene: Day scene shows no boat (the preview's felucca is removed, ADR-008).
NavBar: Silo navigation, Nilecruz wordmark, Day/Night control (ADR-022, ADR-037, Q8).
Hero: Different nav links and search data in the slot; Nilecruz wordmark (ADR-022, ADR-037).
CruiseCard: Nilecruz score instead of stars on two cards, information-only third card, card links (ADR-009, ADR-019).
ExperienceCard: No felucca default in the second card (ADR-008).
ItineraryTimeline: Last stop text no longer mentions feluccas (ADR-008).
CruiseSearch: Children hint and guest model changed for per-child ages (ADR-012/018).
CabinPicker: Deck names follow the dashboard guide (Lower deck); size shown as m² number.
BookingSummary: Rebuilt around real data: gratuity paid on board, no flights or invented fees (ADR-007/010/011/017).
VesselTypeCard: Sample-data flag shown on each card (DATA-006).
PriceAnatomy: Last factor is 'Transfers' (flights are not part of a cruise price, ADR-011); lining figures (BRAND-024); sample flag.
